name: related-posts-for-wp
title: Related Posts for WordPress
description: Related Posts for WordPress: development tooling.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.test:integration:ajax: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/related-posts-for-wp vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --group ajax
scripts.test:integration:record: wp-env --config=.wp-env.test.json run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/related-posts-for-wp bash -c 'RP4WP_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit-integration.xml.dist --group golden'
scripts.i18n:pot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=wp-content/plugins/related-posts-for-wp wp i18n make-pot . languages/related-posts-for-wp.pot --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,scripts
